Lucid Smith for State Representative
A Vision
You Can Trust.
Practical leadership, clear priorities, and a commitment to serving
every member of our community.
Explore Priorities
Get Involved
Clear direction. Honest service. A stronger community.
About Lucid
Leadership with clarity.
Our community deserves representation that listens carefully,
communicates honestly, and focuses on practical results.
Lucid Smith believes public service should be grounded in
accountability, accessibility, and a clear understanding of the
challenges facing working families, local businesses, and
neighborhoods.
Priorities
Focused on what matters.
Affordable Communities
Support practical solutions that help residents find stable,
attainable housing and build a secure future.

↗
Strong Schools
Invest in students, educators, and the resources that help every
child reach their potential.
Learn more

Responsible Government
Promote transparent decision-making, responsible spending, and
government that remains accountable to the public.
